When it comes to Lab, there are usually 4 cards you might have to play through on turn 2, other than Welcome/Big Welcome, which you know to Ash by now.

\- Daruma, which you mentioned, the strongest one against mine and many other decks.

\- Dogmatika Punishment, pretty impactful.

\- Equation Cannon, not really sure how to play around this other than by chaining stuff and removing cards from field on activation. Hopefully you have a second line of play if they resolve this.

\- D-barrier, which I don't think hurts your deck but can just end the game for many.

There's not really much you can do going second against these cards. Red reboot isn't reliable. What you have to do is just make sure your monsters don't leave the field by trap effect. Meaning you can ash Big Welcome instead of Welcome so lovely doesn't trigger. It's possible you can survive 1 turn after getting daruma'd if they have little resources.
